finalReading.passage: When Anna first moved to China, she could not read a single character and often felt lost. Instead of giving up, she learned a few new characters every day and asked her friends whenever she was unsure. A year later, she could read simple signs and menus on her own, and she felt proud of how far a little daily effort had taken her.

questions.q: What did Anna do instead of giving up?
options: She learned a few characters each day and asked friends when unsure.
She stopped trying to read Chinese.
She moved back to her own country.
She only spoke English to everyone.
questions.explanation: 原文 'learned a few new characters every day and asked her friends whenever she was unsure' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Anna feel a year later?
options: Proud of what her daily effort had achieved.
questions.explanation: 末句 'felt proud of how far a little daily effort had taken her'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
